pr_title: modem: hl7800: validate IPv4 DNS addr len for IPv6
pr_body:
If the IPv6 DNS address is not a valid address, DNS will fallback to the IPv4 DNS address.
Ensure the length of the IPv4 DNS address is valid before trying to use it for DNS.

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/67958

review_comments:
The `n` in `strncpy` is the size of the destination, I think the fix should be
```
strncpy(iface_ctx.dns_v6_string, iface_ctx.dns_v4_string, sizeof(iface_ctx.dns_v6_string) - 1);
```
given that `iface_ctx.dns_v6_string` is initialized to `0` it will always be terminated
